Meta-analysis of prognostic studies: Ki-67 data

Source: R/data.R
Ki67.Rd

A dataset from a meta-analysis of prognostic studies evaluating the prognostic value of Ki-67 expression in early breast cancer. The dataset contains study-level overall survival, hazard-ratio, and median survival-time data.

Usage

Ki67

Format

A list of 3 datasets:

OS

Dataset containing overall survival data. It includes author (study author), study (study identifier), t (follow-up time in month), n1 and n0 (sample sizes in the two comparison groups), and s1 and s0 (survival probabilities in the two groups).

HR

Dataset containing hazard-ratio data. It includes author (study author), study (study identifier), HR (hazard ratio), and ci.low and ci.up (lower and upper confidence limits of the hazard ratio).

mct

Dataset containing median follow-up time data. It includes author (study author), study (study identifier), n1 and n0 (sample sizes in the two comparison groups), mct_mo (median follow-up time in months), s1_mct and s0_mct (survival probabilities at median follow-up time in the two comparison groups).

Source

de Azambuja E, Cardoso F, de Castro G, Colozza M, Mano MS, Durbecq V, Sotiriou C, Larsimont D, Piccart-Gebhart MJ, Paesmans M (2007). Ki-67 as prognostic marker in early breast cancer: a meta-analysis of published studies involving 12 155 patients. British Journal of Cancer, 96(10), 1504–1513. doi:10.1038/sj.bjc.6603756

Examples

data(Ki67)

# Overall survival data
head(Ki67$OD)
#> NULL

# Hazard-ratio data
head(Ki67$HR)
#>         author study    HR ci.low  ci.up
#> 1   bevilacqua     1  2.75   1.02   7.39
#> 2         caly     4  1.95   0.92   4.14
#> 3 domagala_no-     5  3.04   1.03   8.99
#> 4 domagala_no+     6  1.38   0.66   2.86
#> 5       erdern     7 17.23   2.42 122.36
#> 6       fresno     8  1.81   0.71   4.59

# Median follow-up time data
head(Ki67$MT)
#>       author study  n1  n0 mct_mo s1_mct s0_mct
#> 1 bevilacqua     1  94  13   74.0   0.79   0.84
#> 2     erdern     7  13  34   72.5   0.60   0.97
#> 3     fresno     8  84  62   75.0   0.75   0.90
#> 4    goodson    11  56  56   61.2   0.75   0.90
#> 5     jansen    15 153 168  128.0   0.43   0.60
#> 6     jensen    16  54  64  104.0   0.68   0.90
